newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed flat at 43.2900/2950 to the dollar in a dull interbank session on Sunday, dealers said.
They said high call rates and weekend closure of major international markets kept the importers away.

Call money was traded in wide range at 9 to 12 percent, down from Saturday's 12-14 percent. Call money turned slightly softer after the central bank extended taka loans to some banks from its discount window. Dealers expect the call rates to drop sharply on Monday when the market receives 5.42 billion taka against some previously matured central bank bills.
